facility.name: Future Stars Learning Place
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: At inspection, cleaning products and aerosols were present in the children's bathroom; cleaning products were present on the food preparation kitchen counter tops; 2 lawnmowers and 2 leaf blowers were present in the backyard.     Note: the primary caregiver was able to remove the hazards from the kitchen and bathroom at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: 1 out of 4 children is missing the health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: 1 out of 2 staff is expired on CPR/1st aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian: The statement of health for a new pet dog is missing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §747.3703(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The playground has construction waste along the fence line that should be removed to prevent injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Training Requirements-Original Training Certification Card or Letter in each Employee's Personnel record: The training certificates for the primary caregiver are missing and will be sent to CCR for evaluation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Training Requirements-Original Training Certification Card or Letter in each Employee's Personnel record (26 TAC §747.1327(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Certificate Not Renewed: The director's certificate expired on 05/03/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Certificate Not Renewed (26 TAC §747.1149)

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The fire drill practices was not availabe to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian: The puppy that was observed at the playground  did not have a  statement of health  made  available to Licensing  for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §747.3703(b))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: The puppy that was observed at the playground  did not have a vaccination record available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: 3 out of 4 children's files needs name, address and/or phone number of the emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: The puppy that is now a pet in the home needs a vaccination record, made available for Licensing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible: A marked bottle of bleach water was stored on the children's bathroom sink counter     Note: this was corrected at time of inspection when the primary caregiver removed the cleaning product.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible (26 TAC §747.3203(13))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian: The puppy that is now a pet in the home needs a statement of health, made available to Licensing for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §747.3703(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There are many large items being stored in the active outdoor playspace that should be removed and stored out of reach of children, such as: a punching bag on a tripod for adult, tire rims, a water table filled with rainwater, cooking grill, miscellaneous trash. 1 large plastic outdoor equipment is cracking and has sharp edges.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: The feeding instruction form has not been updated since 7/26/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §747.2321(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products: The operation did not have a children's product certificate in the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products (26 TAC §747.3935(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: No documentation showing fire drills completed monthly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: During the inspection I observed 5 out of 7 mats used for napping had rips in the mats exposing the foam pad.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §747.4303(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One out of eight children records reviewed was missing the authorization signature for emergency medical care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File: Two out of eight children records reviewed were missing a physician's health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two out of eight children records were missing emergency contact information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Parents' Phone Numbers: One out of eight children records reviewed was missing the phone number for parent(s).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Parents' Phone Numbers (26 TAC §747.605(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Three out of eight children records reviewed were missing health care information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-List of Employees: There is no list of employees posted at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-List of Employees (26 TAC §747.401(a)(5))
